title: Transfer: Edge Vision Benchmark Frontier
goal: Aggregate benchmark runs for edge vision models, keep configurations above a required validation-accuracy floor, and output the Pareto-optimal trade-offs between accuracy and mean latency to `/root/edge_model_frontier.csv`.
skillBenefitRationale: 任务本质是对模型配置的多目标结果做 Pareto 前沿提取；除基础分组、过滤和排序外，不依赖其他专门技能。
